svg.text: VALLEY GUARD 2EC
INSECTICIDE FOR ALMONDS AND STONE FRUIT
ACTIVE INGREDIENT
CAUTION
KEEP OUT OF REACH OF CHILDREN
PRECAUTIONARY STATEMENTS
Harmful if swallowed, inhaled or absorbed through skin. Avoid contact
with skin, eyes or clothing. Wash thoroughly with soap and water after
handling and before eating, drinking or using tobacco.
PERSONAL PROTECTIVE EQUIPMENT (PPE)
Applicators and other handlers must wear: long-sleeved shirt and long
pants, chemical-resistant gloves, and shoes plus socks.
FIRST AID
If on skin or clothing:
Take off contaminated clothing. Rinse skin immediately with plenty of
water for 15-20 minutes. Call a poison control center or doctor.
If in eyes:
Hold eye open and rinse slowly with water for 15-20 minutes.
If swallowed:
Call a poison control center (1-800-222-1222). Do not induce vomiting.
Restricted-Entry Interval (REI): 12 hours. Do not enter or allow
worker entry into treated areas during the REI.
ENVIRONMENTAL HAZARDS: This product is toxic to fish and highly toxic to bees.
EPA Reg. No. 00000-000. Net contents 2.5 gal (9.46 L). Valley Guard Crop Protection, Modesto, CA
